# Remonté — proposition visuelle v1

Illustration de fiction produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Anatomie et consultation proposées ; les figures humaines sont anonymes.

[Image](remontes-v1.png)

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a cinematic painterly photoreal fantasy bestiary illustration of an REMONTE, an original instinctive non-living creature associated with traces of the dead. Scene: intimate medieval stone consultation chamber, soft side daylight and a few candles. Main subject is an unmistakably alien nonhuman creature with slender articulated supporting limbs and an upright open cage-shaped torso made of smooth curved pale mineral-cartilage arches. Inside the open thoracic cage hang multiple delicate translucent vocal membranes of different sizes stretched between flexible arcs, like organic resonant sails, clearly visible and beautifully detailed. One large lower membrane is taut, others slack; several small bodily voice apertures open along the torso. No human skull, no human corpse, no gore, no ghost faces, no floating souls, no skeleton person or resurrected father. Small asymmetrical upper sensory structure tilts gently to one side with a subtle familiar listening gesture; no realistic human face, no grin. The gesture feels briefly recognizable while the anatomy remains foreign. A medieval adult woman in simple dignified wool clothing stands in the near side foreground, seen in profile or three quarter rear, emotionally attentive and uncertain rather than terrified. An anonymous robed human supervisor remains discreet in deeper background, observing. Creature takes the central majority of frame, its full cage torso and supporting limbs visible; the woman provides scale but does not obscure membranes. Mood: tragic tenderness and unsettling recognition, morally neutral animal, quiet encounter. Dusty stone, aged wood, parchment on nearby table, tactile nacreous arches, slightly iridescent membranes, warm ivory and muted brown palette. No magic beams, no spectral human figure, no text or captions, no watermark. Landscape composition, original medieval magical civilization, high-end realistic fantasy art. Proposed visual anatomy.
